description: A Java version manager for Windows - install, switch and pin JDKs with no admin rights.
notes: Run `jdk setup` once to finish: it registers JAVA_HOME, prepends the shims to PATH and materializes them. Scoop cannot do it for you - its hooks fire on `scoop update` as well as on uninstall, so a package that ran setup from one would re-run it behind your back.

Before `scoop uninstall jdk`, run `jdk setup --undo` to hand those settings back. It keeps the JDKs you installed; `jdk setup --undo --purge` deletes the store and them with it. Uninstalling removes only the files scoop placed.
##: checkver and autoupdate are inert while this manifest is installed by URL from a release asset - scoop only re-reads that URL. They are here so the same file works unchanged in a bucket, where a manifest without them would silently rot.
